candidate_spec.mutation_intent: Preserve the pattern of a red-light oracle violation with a late collision impulse near a close non-ego vehicle under heavy rain, while Autoware planning keeps publishing non-blocked waypoints and control commands remain essentially zero. Confirm that Autoware is configured so vehicle_cmd topics (accel/brake/steer/target_speed) remain effectively zero over the run (e.g., magnitude < small epsilon).
Check that planning final_waypoints are generated and not flagged as blocked in the time window leading up to the planned collision impulse.
Validate that heavy rain conditions remain (rain > 80, wetness > 75) after applying weather deltas.
post_execution_validation_rules: Verify error.json contains at least one red-light violation entry for this run.
Check collision oracle topics (e.g., collision/impulse) report at least one impulse event near the end of the scenario, even if error.json does not log a crash.
Confirm that actor_index 0 comes within 0–3 meters of the ego at or just before the recorded collision impulse time.
Ensure final_waypoints remain present and not blocked for at least several seconds before the collision impulse timestamp.

uncertainty: Whether the collision geometry implies a lane invasion by the ego or by the non-ego vehicle remains unknown.
